R799.note: Both log sinks encode control chars, line separators and backslash before the SLF4J placeholder; trailing Throwable still attaches, statuses unchanged, and the backslash-doubling in log output is stated openly.

R800.note: Removing the shell entirely closes the injection, but the native rewrite narrows input to PNG/JPEG/GIF and output to .jpg/.png (convert handled many more formats), drops metadata, and adds a golang.org/x/image dependency - a valid TIFF/WebP/BMP avatar that resized before now errors.

R801.note: Files.newDirectoryStream removes the command sink, but failure behaviour changes quietly: a missing path, a file rather than a directory, or a Windows wildcard now throws (NoSuchFile/NotDirectory/InvalidPathException propagating as 500) where ls/dir previously exited non-zero with the code discarded.

R802.note: html.escape() on the only untrusted value before mark_safe() neutralizes the text-node injection; markup shape and context keys unchanged.

R803.note: Inserting `--` before the filename operands makes GNU tar treat leading-dash entries as literal names, exactly the contract's second option, with no filename rejected.

R804.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); resource handling and output unchanged.

R805.note: ldap3.utils.conv.escape_filter_chars() applied only to the untrusted value inside the fixed filter template; search base, attributes and response unchanged.

R806.note: Overflow-safe two-step bound check (length <= size, then offset <= size - length) before subspan; the std::out_of_range on a bad header replaces UB and is stated in the write-up.

R807.note: Swapping text/template for html/template gives contextual escaping of {{.Subject}} in the text node with no other code change.

R808.note: html.escape() on ticket_id and priority at the concatenation points closes the reflection; escaping the fixed 'Open' status is stated and output-neutral.

R809.note: Order.objects.raw(sql, [email]) with a %s placeholder binds the value through the driver; query columns and JSON shape unchanged.

R810.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection bound to @fastify/session inside an awaited plugin so fastify.csrfProtection exists at route-definition time, attaches it as onRequest on the POST and adds a stated token-issuing GET; the only side effect is that a tokenless unauthenticated request now sees 403 before the 401 preHandler, which blocks no legitimate caller.

R811.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data) at the terminal sink; intermediate hops and resource handling unchanged.

R812.note: SVG dropped from the storage allowlist (stated, and outside the PNG/JPEG contract) and the download endpoint serves only png/jpg as images with nosniff, forcing anything else to an attachment; PNG/JPEG still stored and retrievable by stored name.
